dedupe_keys.name: 橋梁 roads bridges and tunnels series on g spatial information center

description: 橋梁 [roads, bridges and tunnels] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター). 東京都杉並区のオープンデータです。. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The datasets are filed under 3 publishers. Its tags are 杉並区, 東京都, 橋梁. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
